learned.selection: Lowest converged final training penalized objective; no labels or test scores.

screen.interpretation: Exploratory development screen; confirmation uses fleet-paired bootstrap intervals. Coverage support is reported separately from compatible sharing.

notes: The original three fleets are development only.
Same13 uses identical physical vehicles, 18 records per fleet, and 12 seconds per record. The six original 13 m/s clients keep their exact local records and fits.
Only the six unchanged targets enter the paired complementary versus same-speed endpoint.
Confirmation requires a saved freeze lock after complete development analysis and a passing compatible-sharing screen.
All original physical assumptions, integration, inputs, bounds, starts and penalty weights are inherited without modification.
